commands.does: Ask the agent to port a function, module or whole app to Rust with record/diff/gate checks

cli.does: Installs the rust-anything CLI the skill drives (or: cargo install rust-anything)

notes: rust-anything runs the original code to record its behaviour: keep that language's runtime installed (Node 22.6+, Python 3.9+, Go 1.21+, Ruby 3+, or JDK 17+).
